name: caffeinity-skills
description: Caffeinity skills marketplace: editing, teaching, recruiting, SEO, release-preflight, and multi-agent tournament plugins.

plugins.name: wordsmith
plugins.description: Teaches your agent to edit, not just generate: 44 commands across 5 disciplines that tighten, rewrite, critique and proofread while keeping the author's meaning, hedges and voice intact.

plugins.name: recruiter-lens
plugins.description: Reviews resumes, CVs and LinkedIn profiles the way recruiters screen them: first-impression scans, ATS compatibility, rejection-pattern diagnosis and interview prep. Never invents a metric.

plugins.name: deep-tutor
plugins.description: A world-class teacher for any topic, from zero background toward expert depth, in eight modes from foundations and curricula to strict exams and ELI5.

plugins.name: do-better
plugins.description: When an answer is bad, runs a single-elimination tournament of sub-agents with different strategy cards until one solution survives.

plugins.name: keyword-guard
plugins.description: Plans topic clusters and kills keyword cannibalization so exactly one page wins each query, with a mandatory cannibalization audit before content changes.

plugins.name: web-preflight
plugins.description: Checks a site you own before you ship it, treating status codes as signals rather than findings; unrun checks are reported as INCONCLUSIVE, never a pass.
